reviews.matching_title: Mortgage rates remain elevated in the latest weekly survey; 30-year fixed near recent highs
reviews.claim_status: Bounded statistic corroborated; latest-release context corrected
reviews.summary: Freddie Mac's official Primary Mortgage Market Survey recorded a 7.40% 30-year fixed mortgage average on both October 8 and October 15, 2026. The October 15 release was the more recent published weekly observation; citing October 8 as the latest weekly release on October 16 was outdated.

sources_checked.finding: Freddie Mac's official 2026 weekly archive lists October 15, 2026: 30-year FRM 7.40%, 15-year FRM 6.71%; October 8, 2026: 30-year FRM 7.40%, 15-year FRM 6.73%.
Freddie Mac's October 15 release states that the 30-year fixed-rate mortgage averaged 7.40%, unchanged from October 8.

reviews.what_is_known: The stated 7.40% weekly average is supported by Freddie Mac's own data, subject to the PMMS sample methodology.
reviews.what_is_not_established: The 7.40% weekly average does not establish any particular lender's current quote or any intraday rate.
reviews.resolution_needed: Use the most recent available PMMS release and distinguish weekly observation date from story publication date.
